integrity: Standalone proof and finite checker provided; finite checks are not substitutes for the all-parameter arguments; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Rank-three only, ordinary graph language; smallest representatives only within finite Kneser family. Partial older three-pebble Kneser comparisons and the two-existentially-closed definition are prior work; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Eight rank-three theories of finite Kneser graphs and the sharp Rado threshold
